transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I... I’m here because I keep thinking maybe it’d be better if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes it feels like dying would be... a fair punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
I don’t know… I guess I feel pretty low a lot. Empty, maybe. It’s hard to tell anymore.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Not really. I used to paint, cook a lot, go running before jobs… even theater rehearsals. Now it all just feels like chores, like it belonged to somebody else. I don’t really care if I miss any of it.
Do you feel guilty about something specific that you've done?

Yeah… specific enough, I guess. I keep thinking I’m the reason everything got worse. My husband, the crew losing work, clients’ homes getting messed up… like I poisoned everything I touched. Like whatever happens to me, I probably earned it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a year and a couple months, I think. It started a few months after my husband got hurt, and it just kind of stayed.
Have you had any periods in the last year where you felt better for a couple of months before feeling low again?

Not really for a couple months, no. Some weeks weren’t as bad… but most of the time it’s still been there. The guilt, being worn out, not caring about things… and the death thoughts. It hasn’t really let up like that.
Have you had any periods in the last year where you felt completely back to your normal self?

No… I don’t think so. Maybe a few weeks felt less heavy, but I never really felt like me again. Most of the time it’s still been the guilt, being exhausted, not caring much, and… those thoughts about death.
Do your low feelings seem to follow any kind of pattern throughout the year?

Not really. It’s mostly just… been there most of the time. Some weeks aren’t as crushing, but the guilt and being exhausted, not caring about much, and those thoughts about death… they don’t really follow a season or anything.
Does the time of year have any effect on how you're feeling?

No… I haven’t noticed the time of year changing it much. It’s mostly just been there—guilt, being tired all the time, not caring about much, and those thoughts about death. Some weeks are a little less awful, but it doesn’t seem seasonal.
Have you felt this way for two years or more?
No… not two years. It’s been maybe about a year and a couple months, since a few months after my husband got hurt.
Have you had two months or more where your symptoms were less severe?
Not really… I mean, there have been weeks that weren’t as bad, but I don’t think I’ve had two whole months where it let up. Most of the time it’s still been there.
Have you had any periods in the last year where your symptoms completely went away for at least two months?

No… I don’t think it ever completely went away like that. Some weeks were… less heavy, I guess, but most of the time the guilt and exhaustion and not caring, and those thoughts… they’ve still been there.
Have your low feelings and thoughts been present for most of the day, nearly every day, since they started?
Yeah… most days. It’s been there for about a year and a couple months now, since a few months after my husband got hurt. Not really gone for long.
Have you had any time in the last year where you felt completely well for at least two weeks?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been going on about a year and five months now, since my husband’s back injury left him mostly stuck at home. I don’t remember feeling completely well for two weeks.
Have you been feeling this way for two years or more now?
No… not two years. It’s been about a year and five months, since my husband’s back injury left him mostly stuck at home.
Have you been feeling this way for two years or more now?
No… it hasn’t been two years. More like about a year and five months, since my husband’s back injury made him mostly stuck at home.
Have you been feeling this way for at least two years now?
No… not two years. Like I said, it’s been about a year and five months, since my husband hurt his back and got mostly stuck at home.
Have you noticed any significant improvement in your symptoms over the past two months?
Not really… I can’t say I’ve noticed much improvement. It’s mostly felt the same.
Have you been feeling this way for at least two years now?
No… it’s not been two years. It’s been about a year and five months, since my husband hurt his back and’s been mostly stuck at home.
Have you had any significant improvement in your symptoms over the last few months that lasted for more than a couple of weeks?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really had a stretch where it got better for that long.
